text: Welcome to Module 1. In this lesson we introduce the course platform, explain how modules are structured, and show where to find transcripts and practice exercises.
Each module ends with a short recap quiz. Pause the video at any time and use the Q&A widget to ask questions about what you just watched.
Module 2 covers core concepts. We walk through the three building blocks of the demo curriculum: observation, practice, and reflection.
When you practice a new skill, start with a low-stakes exercise before moving to the graded assignment at the end of the module.
Module 3 is the hands-on lab. Follow along with the sample workflow and note the checkpoints where you should verify your results.
If you get stuck, rewatch the segment from the timestamp cited in the Q&A answer, then retry the lab step before submitting.
